---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Goal

The user-visible outcome this change should deliver, in one or two sentences.

## Scope

Files, modules, or surfaces this change should touch. Call out anything that is explicitly out of scope.

## Success criteria

- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ]

Each item is verifiable (a test passes, a metric moves, a flow works end to end). These three fields feed the Plan section of the PR template; keep them specific enough for a planner agent to lift them directly.

## Context (optional)

Links, prior discussion, or background that helps someone pick this up.
